fact: The entrance consists of heavy double doors with a stone diorama inside.
source_quote: a set of heavy double doors, beyond which stood a stone diorama
subject: Lost Tomb of Khaem

fact: Brysis of Khaem is a Netherese sorcerer depicted in her prime in the tomb's diorama.
source_quote: depicting the Netherese sorcerer Brysis of Khaem in her prime
subject: Brysis of Khaem

fact: The diorama shows Brysis surrounded by attendants, slaves, and trappings of an empire.
source_quote: surrounded by attendants and slaves and all the trappings of an empire long since turned to dust
subject: stone diorama

fact: Jimjar demands a bet before reaching the tomb doors.
source_quote: Jimjar felt the irresistible pull of his gambling instincts and demanded a bet
subject: Jimjar demands bet

fact: Gyrgum wagers that the crystals will come in handy.
source_quote: Gyrgum obliged, wagering that the crystals would come in handy after all
subject: Gyrgum wagers on crystals

fact: Jimjar accepts Gyrgum's wager about the crystals.
source_quote: and a startled Jimjar took it
subject: Jimjar accepts wager

fact: Jimjar offers a bet that no one will agree whether the crystals were useful, but nobody takes it.
source_quote: tried, without a single taker, to bet that no one would ever agree whether the crystals had been useful
subject: failed bet offer

fact: A soft, feminine voice pleads for help telepathically.
source_quote: A soft, feminine voice drifted into their minds
subject: trapped voice

fact: The voice claims to have been trapped in the dark for a very long time.
source_quote: begging to be freed from the dark where she had been trapped "for so long. So very long."
subject: trapped voice

fact: The voice gives the party a sense of the tomb entrance's direction.
source_quote: The voice gave them a sense of the tomb's entrance
subject: voice guides party

fact: A roll of 24 on Arcana confirms the tomb belongs to Brysis and contains powerful magic.
source_quote: a 24 on Arcana confirmed this was truly Brysis's Netherese tomb and that powerful magic lay within
subject: Arcana check 24

fact: The GM notes that Netherese notions of good and evil may differ from the party's.
source_quote: The GM added a reminder that Netherese notions of good and evil may not map to the party's own
subject: GM

fact: A staircase descends over a hundred feet into the earth.
source_quote: descended a long staircase that plunged over a hundred feet into the earth
subject: long staircase

fact: A Netherese calendar stone is set into the wall of the staircase.
source_quote: passing a Netherese calendar stone set into the wall along the way
subject: Netherese calendar stone

fact: Gyrgum takes the lead in the party.
source_quote: Gyrgum took the lead
subject: Gyrgum takes lead

fact: The GM considers Daz more fungible in a disaster.
source_quote: the magic user Daz was "more fungible in a disaster"
subject: Daz

fact: The shrine contains shredded tapestries and friezes gouged beyond recognition.
source_quote: found a shrine with shredded tapestries and friezes gouged beyond recognition
subject: shrine

fact: A cracked marble altar is in the shrine and shows signs of recent violence.
source_quote: and a cracked marble altar that had clearly been the target of recent violence
subject: cracked marble altar

fact: The party notes that tomb contents are oddly intact after thousands of years.
source_quote: noted how oddly intact everything was after thousands of years
subject: tomb contents

fact: Floating undead are responsible for the damage in the shrine.
source_quote: Gyrgum studied the damage carefully and concluded that the culprits were floating undead
subject: floating undead

fact: Floating undead leave no tracks in the dust.
source_quote: creatures that left no tracks in the thick layer of dust on the floor
subject: floating undead

fact: Gyrgum recalls undead lore from his days with Bahamut.
source_quote: He remembered from his days with Bahamut
subject: Bahamut

fact: Floating undead do not rest and are driven to keep searching.
source_quote: undead don't rest but are driven to keep searching
subject: floating undead

fact: Floating undead tend to hate things they were associated with in life.
source_quote: he suggested they tend to hate things they were associated with in life
subject: floating undead

fact: Fargas Rumblefoot is referenced by the party as a source of information.
source_quote: The party also recalled Fargas Rumblefoot's tip
subject: Fargas Rumblefoot

fact: Fargas Rumblefoot tipped that the tomb held a secret, false tomb.
source_quote: the tomb held a secret, false tomb
subject: secret false tomb
